mapper.update: UPDATE pjt_approval_documents SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, current_step = #{currentStep}, version = #{version}, file_group_id = #{fileGroupId}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} - 1

choose.when:
AND id IN ( SELECT document_id FROM pjt_approval_lines WHERE approver_id = #{viewerId} AND line_type = 'NOTIFY'
AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'SKIPPED')
AND status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED'
AND status = 'PENDING'
)

if.test: status != null and status != '' and box != 'notices'

where.if: AND ( title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR doc_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.update: INSERT INTO pjt_approval_doc_seq (seq_date, seq_value) VALUES (#{seqDate}, 1) ON CONFLICT (seq_date) DO UPDATE SET seq_value = pjt_approval_doc_seq.seq_value + 1
mapper.select: SELECT seq_value FROM pjt_approval_doc_seq WHERE seq_date = #{seqDate}
